answer: Each submission hangs on the vault of a task receipt, and the juniper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. Reaching the anchor of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on automated market makers with concentrated liquidity. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
